```{r}
#| label: map-data
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(htmltools)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(stringr)
})

source("R/data_helpers.R")

char <- load_characteristic_data()
case <- load_case_data()

not_reported <- function(x) {
  x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
  !nzchar(x) | str_to_upper(x) %in% c("NA", "N/A", "UNKNOWN")
}

classify_g6pd_policy <- function(x) {
  y <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    not_reported(y) ~ "Not reported",
    str_detect(y, "not required|does not require|no g6pd|not recommend") ~ "Testing not required",
    str_detect(y, "quantitative") & str_detect(y, "required|mandatory") ~ "Quantitative testing required",
    str_detect(y, "quantitative") ~ "Quantitative testing recommended",
    str_detect(y, "qualitative") ~ "Qualitative testing recommended",
    str_detect(y, "recommend|should|testing") ~ "Testing recommended; method unspecified",
    TRUE ~ "Other policy"
  )
}

classify_implementation <- function(x) {
  y <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    not_reported(y) ~ "Not reported",
    str_detect(y, "not implement|not yet|not conducted|no implementation") ~ "Not implemented",
    str_detect(y, "pilot|partial|selected|limited|plan|feasibility") ~ "Partial / planned",
    str_detect(y, "implement|roll.?out|routine|available|provided") ~ "Implemented",
    TRUE ~ "Other / unclear"
  )
}

classify_health_level <- function(x) {
  y <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    not_reported(y) ~ "Not reported",
    str_detect(y, "community|volunteer|village|health post") ~ "Community / health post",
    str_detect(y, "health cent|primary|district") ~ "Health centre / primary care",
    str_detect(y, "hospital|tertiary|referral") ~ "Hospital / referral level",
    TRUE ~ "Other / mixed level"
  )
}

classify_patient_group <- function(x) {
  y <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    str_detect(y, "no testing|testing not available|testing unavailable|unknown g6pd") ~ "Testing unavailable",
    str_detect(y, "intermediate|moderate|mild") ~ "Intermediate / mild deficiency",
    str_detect(y, "severe|deficien") ~ "Severe / deficient",
    str_detect(y, "normal") ~ "G6PD normal",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

classify_radical_cure <- function(x) {
  y <- str_to_lower(str_squish(x))
  case_when(
    not_reported(y) ~ "Not reported",
    str_detect(y, "no primaquine|primaquine.*not|not recommend") ~ "No primaquine",
    str_detect(y, "tafenoquine") & str_detect(y, "primaquine|\\bpq\\b") ~ "Primaquine or tafenoquine",
    str_detect(y, "tafenoquine") ~ "Tafenoquine",
    str_detect(y, "weekly|8 weeks") ~ "Weekly primaquine for 8 weeks",
    str_detect(y, "7 day") & str_detect(y, "14 day") ~ "7- or 14-day primaquine",
    str_detect(y, "7 day") ~ "7-day primaquine",
    str_detect(y, "14 day") ~ "14-day primaquine",
    str_detect(y, "primaquine|\\bpq\\b") ~ "Other primaquine regimen",
    TRUE ~ "Other policy"
  )
}

map_rows <- char |>
  transmute(
    country = trimws(.data$Country),
    region = trimws(.data$Region),
    who_region = trimws(.data$`WHO Region`),
    reporting = trimws(.data$`Reporting vivax cases (<5 years)`),
    cases_2023 = trimws(.data$`2023 Case Numbers`),
    first_line = trimws(.data$`Pv 1st line treatment`),
    second_line = trimws(.data$`Pv 2nd line treatment`),
    g6pd_guidelines_summary = trimws(.data$`Guidelines G6PD testing  (Y/N)`),
    g6pd_implementation_summary = trimws(.data$`Implementation: G6PD testing  (Y/N)`),
    g6pd_type = trimws(.data$`Type of G6PD testing`),
    program_phase = trimws(.data$`Program Phase`)
  ) |>
  filter(nzchar(.data$country))

# Only explicitly approved policy fields are classified for the browser payload.
# Raw notes, contacts, comments, links, and other free text are never embedded.
case_main <- case |>
  filter(.data$Country %in% map_rows$country) |>
  group_by(.data$Country) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    country = trimws(.data$Country),
    g6pd_policy = classify_g6pd_policy(.data$`Policy on G6PD Testing`),
    g6pd_implementation = classify_implementation(.data$`Implementation of G6PD Testing`),
    treatment_implementation = classify_implementation(.data$`Implementation of Treatment`),
    g6pd_health_level = classify_health_level(.data$`Health System Level of G6PD Implementation`),
    treatment_health_level = classify_health_level(.data$`Health System Level of Treatment Implementation`),
    last_policy_update = coalesce(
      str_extract(str_squish(.data$`Last Policy Update`), "(19|20)\\d{2}"),
      ""
    )
  )

map_rows <- map_rows |>
  left_join(case_main, by = "country") |>
  mutate(
    across(
      c(g6pd_policy, g6pd_implementation, treatment_implementation,
        g6pd_health_level, treatment_health_level),
      ~ coalesce(.x, "Not reported")
    ),
    last_policy_update = coalesce(.data$last_policy_update, "")
  )

country_prefixes <- map_rows$country[order(nchar(map_rows$country), decreasing = TRUE)]
base_country_for <- function(value) {
  if (is.na(value) || !nzchar(value)) return(NA_character_)
  hit <- country_prefixes[str_starts(value, paste0(country_prefixes, " -"))]
  if (length(hit)) hit[[1]] else NA_character_
}

case_sub <- case |>
  mutate(base_country = vapply(.data$Country, base_country_for, character(1))) |>
  filter(!is.na(.data$base_country)) |>
  mutate(
    status_text = str_sub(.data$Country, nchar(.data$base_country) + 4L),
    patient_group = classify_patient_group(.data$status_text),
    radical_cure_policy = classify_radical_cure(.data$`Policy on PQ`)
  ) |>
  filter(.data$patient_group != "Other") |>
  group_by(.data$base_country, .data$patient_group) |>
  slice(1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    country = .data$base_country,
    patient_group = .data$patient_group,
    radical_cure_policy = .data$radical_cure_policy
  )

map_payload <- list(
  countries = map_rows,
  treatments = case_sub,
  regions = sort(unique(map_rows$region[nzchar(map_rows$region)])),
  health_levels = c(
    "Community / health post",
    "Health centre / primary care",
    "Hospital / referral level",
    "Other / mixed level",
    "Not reported"
  )
)

map_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  map_payload,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  null = "null"
)
map_json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", map_json, fixed = TRUE)
```

::: {.map-intro}
Choose the policy question that determines country colour. Secondary controls
refine the population or countries shown. Hover for a quick answer, or select a
country to keep its details open.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="policy-map-shell">
  <section class="policy-map-controls" aria-label="Map controls">
    <div class="policy-map-control policy-map-control--primary">
      <label for="policy-map-metric">Colour countries by</label>
      <select id="policy-map-metric">
        <option value="radical_cure_policy">Radical-cure treatment policy</option>
        <option value="g6pd_policy">G6PD-testing policy</option>
        <option value="g6pd_implementation">G6PD-testing implementation</option>
        <option value="treatment_implementation">Treatment implementation</option>
        <option value="first_line">First-line treatment</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <div id="policy-map-patient-control" class="policy-map-control">
      <label for="policy-map-patient">Patient G6PD category</label>
      <select id="policy-map-patient">
        <option value="G6PD normal">G6PD normal</option>
        <option value="Intermediate / mild deficiency">Intermediate / mild deficiency</option>
        <option value="Severe / deficient">Severe / deficient</option>
        <option value="Testing unavailable">Testing unavailable</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <div class="policy-map-control">
      <label for="policy-map-region">Region</label>
      <select id="policy-map-region"><option value="">All regions</option></select>
    </div>

    <div id="policy-map-health-control" class="policy-map-control" hidden>
      <label for="policy-map-health">Health-system level</label>
      <select id="policy-map-health"><option value="">All levels</option></select>
    </div>

    <div class="policy-map-control">
      <label for="policy-map-reporting">Reporting status</label>
      <select id="policy-map-reporting">
        <option value="">All statuses</option>
        <option value="Yes">Yes</option>
        <option value="No">No</option>
        <option value="Yes (mixed)">Yes (mixed)</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <button id="policy-map-reset" class="policy-map-reset" type="button">Clear filters</button>
  </section>

  <div id="policy-map-legend" class="policy-map-legend" aria-label="Map legend"></div>
  <p class="policy-map-note">Countries outside the repository are shown in grey.</p>

  <div class="policy-map-content">
    <div class="policy-map-stage">
      <div id="policy-map-status" class="policy-map-status" role="status">Loading country boundaries…</div>
      <svg id="policy-map" class="policy-map" role="img" aria-label="Interactive world map of P. vivax policies"></svg>
      <div id="policy-map-tooltip" class="policy-map-tooltip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>
    </div>

    <aside id="policy-map-details" class="policy-map-details" aria-live="polite">
      <button class="policy-map-details__close" type="button" aria-label="Close country details">×</button>
      <div class="policy-map-details__empty">
        <span class="policy-map-details__eyebrow">Country details</span>
        <h2>Select a country</h2>
        <p>Choose a coloured country on the map to keep its policy summary here.</p>
      </div>
    </aside>
  </div>
</div>
```

cat(as.character(tags$script(

  type = "application/json",
  HTML(map_json)
)))
